designationHistory.indexText: Reelfoot National Wildlife Refuge was established on August 28, 1941, under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (2006 CCP: established August 28, 1941, under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act) found only an FWS source; no executive order appears in the National Archives disposition table for 1941. Pass B found no independent record (a Tennessee state lease or contemporary newspaper report would settle it).

sources.name: FWS, Reelfoot and Lake Isom NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2006)
